title: Reduce silver or copper strip thickness
note: Demonstration scenario for ISOMORPH. The engine is domain independent; see backend/tests/intelligence/test_generality.py for unrelated problems.
statement: Strip made of copper or silver must be reduced in thickness. The strip is 50 mm width and 2 mm thickness. The motor drives the rolls. The rolls reduce the strip. The operator sets the screwdown once per coil. The screwdown sets the roll gap. The roll gap constrains the rolls. Friction dissipates energy at the bite. The thickness variation must not exceed 0.02 mm. The goal is to achieve the target reduction with minimal thickness variation.

parameter_records.name: reduction_percent
parameter_records.source: demo default; change with --reduction on scripts/run_demo.py
parameter_records.notes: Target set by the user, not a physical estimate.

parameter_records.name: roll_radius_mm
parameter_records.source: analyst assumption of 150 to 300 mm diameter work rolls on a small laboratory mill
parameter_records.notes: Not a handbook value. Replace with the actual roll diameter of the mill. Roll flattening is not modelled.

parameter_records.name: friction
parameter_records.source: recalled handbook-level range of about 0.03 to 0.12 for lubricated cold rolling; not checked against a source
parameter_records.notes: Nominal 0.08 is a mid-range choice, not a measurement. The earlier demo value 0.12 is the top of the range. At 20 percent reduction of 2 mm with R = 100 mm the 0.4 mm draft needs friction of about 0.063 or more to bite, so the low end of the range fails the bite condition. Measure friction on the actual lubricant and rolls.

parameter_records.name: mill_modulus_kn_per_mm
parameter_records.source: analyst assumption for a small laboratory mill; no handbook value is claimed
parameter_records.notes: Must come from the mill's measured stretch curve (force versus gap with rolls kissing).

parameter_records.name: roll_force_limit_kn
parameter_records.source: what-if machine rating; the user must supply the real rating
parameter_records.notes: Clearly a what-if value for the demo. It is not varied in the uncertainty analysis.

parameter_records_note: Each record carries source, range basis, confidence and verification. Nothing was checked against a source (no network when written). Not certified data.
